title: fix(plugin-view): the view tab bar takes its host's width, so the list toolbar's tab strip no longer folds to one tab (objectui#12518)
body:
Fixes #12518
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`ViewTabBar`'s root element (`data-testid="view-tab-bar"`) gains `w-full`: the bar takes its container's width. One class on one element. No prop, export or type moves, and the fit algorithm, the overflow trigger, the "N more" menu, the mobile view picker and the host slot's classes are untouched.

## Why

Since objectui#12440 the console hands the bar to the list toolbar's leading slot (`list-toolbar-leading` in `ListView`, a flex row). There the bar's root, with no growth and no width, is sized by its content: the strip inside it (`flex-1`, zero basis) gets a share of the bar's content width, so the width the fit reads is the width of the tabs it is currently drawing. The fit then answers its own previous answer. Every fold narrows the strip, the strip's ResizeObserver re-fits, and the next fold narrows it again, down to one tab and "N more". After that no resize brings tabs back, because the bar stays content-sized whatever the slot does.

## Why `w-full` and not `flex-1` (mechanism assumption A2, measured)

Hosts, enumerated with `git grep` for the JSX mount of `ViewTabBar` (one mount, in app-shell's `ObjectView`, whose element is placed in two hosts), plus hotcrm and objectstack (no mounts):

| Host | Container | `w-full` | `flex-1` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list-toolbar-leading` (`ListView` toolbar) | flex row | bar = slot width (this change) | bar = slot width |
| `view-tab-row` (a refused view, `ObjectView`) | block | unchanged: measured bar 1408 px at 1440 and 668 px at 700, with and without | no effect (not a flex item) |
| a column-flex host (none in this repo; a caller of the published package could have one) | flex column | unchanged: measured bar height 38 px with and without | grows vertically: measured bar height 199.5 px in a 400 px column beside a `flex-1` body |

The mobile view picker does not mount `ViewTabBar` (`MobileViewSwitcherContext` says so, and `git grep` finds no mount there). `w-full` leaves every host except the flex row exactly as it was, so it is the one taken.

## Tests

- New: `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ViewTabBar.hostWidth-12518.test.tsx`. It mounts the bar inside a host that carries the slot's classes. happy-dom lays nothing out, and with no layout every tab shows, so a bare "seven tabs" assertion would pass with no layout at all. The file therefore lays the bar out itself: a one-line row-flex model read from the rendered classes (`flex`, `gap-0.5`, `flex-1`, `w-full`, `min-w-0`, `shrink-0`; tabs 90 px, trigger 72 px, "+" 32 px), plus a `ResizeObserver` stand-in that delivers whenever an observed width moves, round after round until the layout settles. It pins:
  - at an 852 px host, all seven tabs and no trigger, with the strip measured at the host width less the "+" button (818 px). That width is the live control showing the model is in effect;
  - narrowed to 500 px, four tabs and "3 more"; widened back to 852 px, seven;
  - first measured at 200 px (one tab drawn), then 852, 851 and 852 px: seven.
- The narrow width is 500 px, not the card's 400. With 90 px tabs the fit needs 4 × 92 + 80 = 448 px of strip for four tabs beside the trigger's first-draw estimate. A 400 px host leaves 366 px (the "+" takes 34), which the fit answers with three.
- The existing `ViewTabBar` fit tests are unchanged.
- Ablation (one-off; no permanent file): objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the pre-change class string back on the root and ran the new file. All 3 tests went red:
  - `expected 164 to be 818` (the strip collapsed to one 90 px tab, the 72 px trigger and the gap);
  - `expected [ 'v1' ] to deeply equal [ 'v1', 'v2', 'v3', 'v4' ]`;
  - `expected [ 'v1' ] to have a length of 7 but got 1`.
  Restore was proven: the blob after restore equals the HEAD blob (`cb01b5f8b12b`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The direction was red, as expected. The test imports the component relative to `src`, so no `dist/` was in the path.

## Real-Chromium reading (one-off harness, not committed)

The harness was a throwaway preview page served by the console's Vite dev server: workspace sources, the console's real Tailwind build, and Chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers`. It mounts the real `ViewTabBar` (seven views, admin callbacks on) inside the toolbar row, left group and `list-toolbar-leading` chain, with the classes copied from `ListView`. A 240 px sidebar and a 260 px tool cluster stand in for the console's chrome. "Before" is the same component with `className="w-auto"`: tailwind-merge puts that in place of `w-full`, which gives the pre-change root.

| Step | after | before |
|---|---|---|
| load at 1440 (slot 900 px) | 7 tabs, no trigger; bar 900, strip 866 | 1 tab, "6 more"; bar 218.4, strip 184.4 |
| 1440 → 1439 → 1440 | 7, 7 | 1, 1 |
| resize to 1024 (slot 484 px) | 3 tabs, "4 more" | 1 tab, "6 more" |
| back to 1440 | 7 | 1 |
| reload at 1440 | 7 | 1 |
| load at 1024, then 1440 | 3, then 7 | 1, then 1 |

The "before" column is the card's reading again: the card measured bar 224 and strip 190; with these labels it is 218.4 and 184.4.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show (HotCRM Leads list)

- At 1440: all seven tabs, and no overflow trigger.
- At 1024: four tabs and "3 more".
- A 1440 → 1439 → 1440 resize ends with seven.
- A reload at 1440 ends with seven.

The harness's 1024 answer (three tabs) is not a prediction for HotCRM, which has its own sidebar width, tool cluster width and labels.

## Acceptance notes

- The fit adds the strip's 2 px gap after every tab, the last one included (`fitFromWidths`), so "everything fits" needs 2 px of slack past the drawn content. In a content-sized strip that alone tipped the first fit (642 px of strip for 644 px of tabs). With the bar at the slot's width it is harmless slack. Observation only; carrier: none.
